items.source:
Run an application in place using the test runtime classpath. The main class that will
be used to launch the application is determined as follows: The configured main class,
if any. Then the main class found in the test classes directory, if any. Then the main
class found in the classes directory, if any.
items.translation: 使用测试运行时类路径就地运行应用程序。用于启动应用程序的主类的确定方式如下：首先，如果配置了主类，则使用该主类；其次，如果在测试类目录中找到了主类，则使用该主类；最后，如果在 classes 目录中找到了主类，则使用该主类。

items.source:
Returns the directories that contain the application's classes and resources. When
the application's main class has not been configured, each directory is searched in
turn for an appropriate main class.
items.translation: 返回包含应用程序类与资源的目录。当未配置应用程序的主类时，将依次搜索每个目录以查找合适的主类。
